relations.targetName: Data Lineage data dictionary for UI and DBT documentation for Data Lake
relations.description: Providing internal and external guidance to definitions and calculations enabled a shared understanding of metrics. For educators they were able to more fluently speak towards insights against other student performance measures.

Educators leveraged data from the most recent activity to quantify student progress towards usage goals. Varied scheduling created baselines that diluted the value of larger or average snapshots. When planning groups teachers wanted to understand progress by individual student over the last few weeks more than overarching averages or velocity.

By far the most requested feature, documented in both discovery interviews and surveys, as well as quarterly business review feedback. Very nuanced, in that not all data being fresh was the pain, even though that is what was communicated. See discovery slides

relations.targetName: ROAR Progress Page for all roles
relations.description: The precursor to an alerts/needs attention group initiative that surfaces actionable items over raw data that educators can action on.
Observations, Surveys, and Interviews are most validated when paired with usage data (and vice versa).
During observations educators were largely unaware of dashboards, and lacked guidance for best practices to incorporate as an instructional tool vs a mere reporting tool.
